name: Jitta Mil Rha Hai Utte Mei Khush Raho
visual_description: Ayushmann Khurrana gesturing with his index finger warning someone intensely in dim lighting with a caption at the bottom.
usage_context: Used to advise someone to be content with the bare minimum they are receiving (like salary appraisals, perks, or marks) before that too is taken away.

example.caption: HR offering a 3% salary hike after record company profits:

text_areas.description: Situation or scenario describing getting very little
